Helpful news about gate queues
It is for new travelers
Travelers need to know that the Companion Animal Travel Desk is ready to guide every pet journey with calm, clear steps.

Please come to the desk before you move toward boarding. We check carrier fit, document order, and pet comfort so each trip stays safe and steady. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey, and our staff will say plainly what must be done next. If a pet is restless, unsure, or new to air travel, tell us at once so we can help with a direct plan. Aurelia Skyways keeps its companion travel service focused on dependable handling and practical guidance.

Bring any health papers, feeding notes, and comfort items that your animal needs for a smooth handoff. Keep collars secure and carriers closed until a staff member asks for a change. If you are traveling with Coco, or with any other companion animal, we will give the same careful attention and the same brisk, courteous service. We work to reduce delay, but we never skip a safety check or send a pet forward before the record is complete.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk for current guidance before departure.
